Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a mental asylum doctor ordering a schizophrenic patient to take his pills, the patient refuses, and makes him take the pills to prove they are safe. The doctor obliges, but when he opens his eyes, the patient is gone, a figment of his imagination, revealing it was the doctor that was schizophrenic the whole time.  Please use an emoji at the end of every sentence.assistant
response:
INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - DAY 🏥

Dr. Smith, a middle-aged psychiatrist, stands over his patient, Jack, a disheveled young man with sunken eyes, in the dimly lit ward 🌑. Jack's gaze drifts away, lost in thought, as Dr. Smith holds out a small glass of medication 🌟.

DR. SMITH:
"Jack, it's time for your medication. Please take it, it's for your own good 🤝."

JACK:
(whispering) "No... I don't want it... it's poison 💀."

DR. SMITH:
(firmly) "Jack, you need to take your medication. It's the only way to manage your symptoms 📊."

JACK:
(refusing) "I won't take it! You don't know what it does to me 🤯."

DR. SMITH:
(exasperated) "Fine, if you won't take it, I'll take it for you myself 💊."

Dr. Smith forces the pills into Jack's mouth, and Jack spits them out in disgust 🤢.

DR. SMITH:
(frustrated) "Jack, stop being stubborn! I'm trying to help you 🤦‍♂️."

As Dr. Smith looks at Jack, he begins to feel a strange sensation, like his mind is unraveling 🌪️. Suddenly, Jack's face distorts, and he disappears into thin air 👻.

DR. SMITH:
(stunned) "What... what just happened? 🤔"

He looks around the room, but Jack is nowhere to be found 🏃‍♂️. Dr. Smith's eyes widen as he realizes the truth: he's been living in a world of his own creation, and Jack was just a figment of his imagination 🌐.

DR. SMITH:
(whispering) "I'm the one who's been sick... all along 🤯."

The camera zooms out as Dr. Smith's eyes glaze over, and he collapses to the floor, surrounded by the eerie silence of the asylum 🏥.
